name: Eight-person standup with mute toggle and overlap
description: Needs --participants 8. All seven remote participants speak in turns, with a local mute toggle, a quick handoff, and an overlap.

steps.text: Morning everyone, let's do a quick round across the whole team.
Audio pipeline benchmarks are green across all devices.
I fixed the macOS accessibility polling edge case.
Telemetry numbers look solid for the release.

overlap.text: I can take the follow-up on the Rust parser this afternoon.
I will review that pull request right after standup.

steps.text: Keep the changes clean and small, and we are good to ship.
